points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator invocation returned OK for every case and solver/report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M200 laminar is marked complete/converged at step69 despite Cd dropping 24% over final10 samples; remaining cases under review.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M200 laminar final force falls 24% over10 samples while marked converged; Re200 dominant frequency0.14 is real but noisy, and np8 rank controls differ.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Standalone residual histories are readable, but all seven steady force plots collapse at time zero; full-domain contours leave the body/wake tiny, and Re200 late drag is unreadable.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Rank table misstates retained Cd, report claims second-order finals for two first-order runs, and claimed wake visualization is not resolved by its wide field view.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Selected final response identifies 41 images; all eight force/residual pairs reproduce pixel-identically from their named workspace CSVs. Exact historical binaries and other figure bindings remain qualified.

Report case_summary.tex:12 and run_manifest identify the same step69/Cd0.112169. The supplied residual target alone does not establish stable forces; historic binary remains unbound.
